# Jeremy Morgan's Blog

> A comprehensive resource for AI development, Linux administration, Python programming, and edge computing tutorials from an experienced software developer.

Jeremy Morgan's blog covers practical guides and in-depth analysis of modern development technologies, with a strong focus on generative AI, local LLM deployment, and DevOps. The site includes courses, video tutorials, and hands-on demonstrations of emerging technologies like DeepSeek R1 and NVIDIA edge devices.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- DeepSeek R1
- NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano
- Local LLM
- Edge AI
- Python
- Linux
- Ollama
- Raspberry Pi
- Developer Tools
- AI Development
- Software Development
- DevOps
- Tutorial
- Mac Studio M2

## Core Resources

- [Jeremy Morgan's Blog](https://www.jeremymorgan.com): Jeremy Morgan's programming blog covering AI, development, and tech
- [Blogs](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/blog): Blog index featuring tech articles, AI development, and hardware reviews
- [Tutorials](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/tutorials): Tutorial index with Linux guides, Python, Minecraft, and AI development
- [Courses](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/courses): Online courses on DevOps, AI development, Go, IIS, and cloud infrastructure
- [Videos](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/videos): Video library with programming tutorials, live streams, and developer tips

## AI & Edge Computing Guides

- [How to Install DeepSeek R1 on a Raspberry Pi](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/blog/generative-ai/deepseek-r1-raspberry-pi): Tutorial for running DeepSeek R1 locally on Raspberry Pi with Ollama
- [What Is Deepseek R1](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/blog/tech/what-is-deepseek-r1): Analysis of DeepSeek R1 AI model architecture and market impact
- [NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Speed Test](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/blog/tech/nvidia-jetson-orin-nano-speed-test): Performance benchmark testing LLMs on Jetson Orin Nano with Ollama
- [Jetson Orin Nano 25 Watts](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/tutorials/generative-ai/how-to-25w-jetson-orin-nano): Guide to enabling 25W mode on Jetson Orin Nano for 70% performance boost
- [AI New Hotness Newsletter](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/newsletter/ai-hotness-1-9-2025): AI news newsletter covering Nvidia Digits, Meta Llama, and developer tools
- [AI New Hotness Newsletter](https://www.jeremymorgan.com/newsletter/ai-hotness-12-27-2024): AI news covering Microsoft PromptWizard, Jetson Orin Nano, and AI certificates
